checks.evidence: DegreeAtMostTwo explicitly conjoins IsAlgebraic Q z with natDegree(minpoly Q z)<=2. minpoly positive degree then makes the actual degree 1 or 2; transcendental elements cannot enter via the zero minpoly.

Cleared-denominator rational minpoly followed by primPart is nonzero and primitive. A nonzero rational scalar bridge proves unchanged degree, vanishing, irreducibility via Gauss, and nonzero constant coefficient for nonzero z. Does not assume algebraic integrality over Z.

Any primitive irreducible integer polynomial vanishing at z is associated over Q to the monic minpoly, primitive divisibility descends to Z, and integer polynomial units give equality up to sign. Positive-leading representative is proved positive, minimal and unique.

Finite supremum of natAbs coefficients over polynomial support equals the maximum coefficient absolute value, with coefficients outside support zero. Nonzero polynomial gives height at least 1; sign invariance and unique-positive representative bridge are proved.

Mahler uses absolute integer leading coefficient and full complex root multiset with multiplicity; Weil is M^(1/d), where d is the actual primitive/minpoly degree. Sign invariance, exact polynomial bridge, and W^d=M are proved. No equivalence to a separate places-based height definition is claimed or needed for the stated formula-based convention.

For nonzero degree<=2 root, 1<=|a0|<=H*r+H*r^2. With H>=2 and r<H^(-3), exact real arithmetic gives RHS<1. Remaining H<=1 polynomials have bounded integer coefficients and degree; finite union of their finite root sets plus zero proves actual finite set of possible numbers.

Exact constant-term product and separating one root give 1<=r*M. M>=1; W>=1 and degree 1 or 2 give M<=W^2. Thus 1<=r*H^2 for both conventions, incompatible with r<H^(-3). Approximation set is contained in {0}.

Complex approximation uses norm of ofReal(xi)-z. Real predicate uses absolute value. ofReal is injective and norm agrees exactly with absolute value, so finite complex set transfers to finite real set. degreeAtMostTwo_real_iff identifies the real minpoly and algebraicity exactly.
Pcomplex and Preal use Set.Infinite of actual numbers, not an indexed sequence allowing repeated values. Zero itself contributes at most one value.
All predicates use literal real exponent -tau and strict < with coefficient 1. No asymptotic constant, rescaled exponent, big-O proxy, or non-strict replacement is used.
